sloka: स कपिर्वारयामास तं व्योम्नि शरवर्षिणम् ।वृष्टिमन्तं पयोदान्ते पयोदमिव मारुतः ।। ५.४६.२३।।।।
transliteration: sa kapirvārayāmāsa taṁ vyomni śaravarṣiṇam ।vṛṣṭimantaṁ payodānte payodamiva mārutaḥ ।। 5.46.23।।।।

translations.english: The great monkey kept away the showering arrows like the wind prevents raincloud from showering rain drops at the end of monsoon.
